title: Jurisdiction of District Commission Based on Complaint Value

content.scenario: A consumer, Priya, purchases a product worth Rs. 50 lakhs from a company. She wants to file a complaint against the company in the District Commission.
content.outcome: The District Commission has jurisdiction to entertain Priya's complaint, as the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed one crore rupees.

user_queries: What is the jurisdiction of the District Commission based on complaint value?
Can I file a complaint in the District Commission for a product worth Rs. 50 lakhs?
What is the limit for filing a complaint in the District Commission?
